veranderings.blok: Van die oudste rotse op aarde
veranderings.rede: A range is normally given from the smaller to the larger number; same span, same meaning.

veranderings.voor: Om al die rotse se jare te tel
veranderings.na: Om al die jare van die rotse te tel
veranderings.rede: In the original 'al' attaches to 'rotse', which can read as adding up every rock's age; attaching it to 'jare' says what is meant.

veranderings.na: 'n klein stukkie van al daardie jare
veranderings.rede: 'daarvan' could point to the rocks' age or to the 100 years of counting; naming the referent removes the doubt without adding content.

veranderings.voor: natuur soos berge en mere met
veranderings.na: natuur, soos berge en mere, met
veranderings.rede: Commas around the inserted examples make the long sentence easier to parse; the protected 'plekke in die natuur' stays intact.

veranderings.voor: is die meer met hulle voorouers verbind
veranderings.na: word die meer met hulle voorouers verbind
veranderings.rede: The present passive 'word ... verbind' describes a living tradition and matches 'verbind word' in the previous block; 'is ... verbind' reads as a completed past act.
'bewyse oor' calques 'evidence about'; Afrikaans says 'bewyse van'.

veranderings.voor: kan daardie plek ook heilig wees
veranderings.na: kan dieselfde plek ook heilig wees
veranderings.rede: The block's point is one place with two values, and 'dieselfde' says so; note it adds a three-syllable word where the gate's syllable limit is reportedly tight.

veranderings.voor: wat geskryf word as 'n 1 met nege nulle
veranderings.na: wat as 'n 1 met nege nulle geskryf word
veranderings.rede: In an Afrikaans subordinate clause the verb cluster goes to the end; the original follows English word order.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Not proposing a change: AWS practice usually writes adverb plus participle used attributively as one word ('goedbewaarde'); a person may want to confirm the spelling, keeping the full wording that must not be shortened.
